meta.name: add-teams
meta.description: Add Microsoft Teams channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 集成 Microsoft Teams 频道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中添加 Teams 消息通知功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Microsoft Teams channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add Teams messaging to your application

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会通过 Chat SDK 桥接接入 Microsoft Teams,在团队频道、群聊和私信里收发消息;前提是先创建机器人并安装到 Teams。
howto.when: 当你要给助手加上 Microsoft Teams 频道,或要把它接到某个 Teams 账号上时,接管安装流程。

say.text: 帮我把 Microsoft Teams 频道接进来
say.note: 会复制适配器、装依赖并跑注册测试

say.text: 帮我创建 Teams 机器人,名字叫 NanoClaw
say.note: 会登录微软并注册机器人与应用

say.text: 把助手接到我的 Teams 账号上
say.note: 助手会先主动给你发 Teams 私信

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can talk through Microsoft Teams via the Chat SDK bridge — team channels, group chats and DMs. A bot must first be created and installed into Teams.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add a Microsoft Teams channel to the assistant, or to wire it to a Teams account.

say_en.text: Add the Microsoft Teams channel to my assistant
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, installs deps, runs the test

say_en.text: Create the Teams bot and name it NanoClaw
say_en.note: Signs in to Microsoft and registers the bot

say_en.text: Wire the assistant to my Teams account
say_en.note: The assistant DMs you first on Teams
